# Vantage Connections

> Vantage Connections is a luxury web design and development studio headquartered in Irvine, California. We design, build, host, and maintain bespoke websites on a managed-monthly model for luxury real estate professionals (realtors, brokerages, listings, developers) and premium artisan brands (candles, wellness drinks, sea moss, skincare, gourmet goods).

We serve clients in Irvine, Newport Beach, Los Angeles, Austin (TX), Miami (FL), and Orlando (FL), and work remotely with brands nationwide.

## Founders

- Radin Ahmadi — Co-founder
- Adrin Ahmadi — Co-founder
- Daeseo Lee — Co-founder
- Arastoo Gol — Co-founder

## Services

Three managed-monthly tiers. Every tier includes bespoke design, hosting, on-page SEO, mobile-first responsive build, and premium support.

- **Basic — from $150/month.** Clean luxury portfolio sites for solo professionals, realtors, consultants, and personal brands. Standard support.
- **Growth — from $350/month.** SMB sites that scale: ecommerce, lead capture, booking modules, analytics, monthly content edits. Premium support.
- **Premium — from $1,050/month.** Large technical sites with custom backends, integrations, dedicated dev team, A/B testing, marketing & SEO management, and priority SLAs.
